source: Skyfield WGS72 position at original nanosecond UTC; independent numpy WGS84 first ray intersection, except analytic quadratic vertex for unclipped zero-altitude natural endpoints. Shared same-epoch target direction and geometric distance. C0 independent scipy natural roots and independent 576 limb-angle width reference. Model times are query coordinates only.
nearby_source: C0 independent Skyfield position, derotated fourth-order position differences and independent Karney WGS84 geodesics; zero-altitude natural endpoints regenerated independently as scaled ray quadratic vertices at original nanosecond UTC. Reference coordinates rounded to 1e-8 degree and distances to 1e-8 km.

path_limits.source: Skyfield 1.55 / python-sgp4 2.27 WGS72; independent long-double WGS84 ray quadratic and Vincenty inverse; common model geocentric apparent target per C-4 split reference

parameters.tangencies: all discriminant roots and explicit quadratic vertices
parameters.intervals: split at every tangency; refine both cross-track extrema
parameters.time: UTC nanoseconds with library UT1 alignment
